title: Senders
content:
# Senders

Order a dedicated iMessage number, pick one that activates instantly, register a sender you already own, and manage or cancel it

A sender is the unit you buy: one dedicated number, on one profile, that becomes an `imessage` account in the inbox.

Zernio orders it on the delivery provider's Apple-registered infrastructure.

## Order a number

iMessage cannot run on a number you already own with Zernio, because Apple only registers numbers hosted by the provider.

`POST /v1/imessage/senders/order` with the profile, `kind: "phone"` and a `region` of `US` or `GB`.

Every ordered number comes with SMS/RCS fallback with call forwarding and the ability to message contacts who have not written first.

```json
{
  "profileId": "68a1…",
  "kind": "phone",
  "region": "US",
  "purchaseIntentId": "order-2026-09-21-1",
  "contact": { "firstName": "Acme", "lastName": "Support", "photoUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/acme.png" }
}
```

The response is `202` with the sender's lifecycle object in `ordering` or `activating`.

Activation is asynchronous. Poll [`GET /v1/imessage/senders/{senderId}`](/imessage/get-imessage-sender) or listen for the `account.connected` webhook, which carries the new account id. Billing starts at activation.

<Callout type="warn">
Always send a `purchaseIntentId`. The provider-side order is never retried automatically, and a repeated call with the same intent id returns the existing order instead of buying a second number.
</Callout>

### Instant activation

Some numbers are pre-registered with the provider and activate the moment you order them.

List them with [`GET /v1/imessage/senders/available-numbers?region=US`](/imessage/list-imessage-available-numbers). Each item has an `id`, the `phone` and, when known, a `location` such as a US state.

Pass the `id` as `availableNumberId` on the order:

```json
{ "profileId": "68a1…", "kind": "phone", "region": "US", "availableNumberId": "779d18a4-…" }
```

To hold a number while the buyer decides, call [`POST /v1/imessage/senders/available-numbers/{numberId}/reserve`](/imessage/reserve-imessage-available-number) first. The hold lasts 3 minutes.

**Empty pool.** The pool is a snapshot and changes over time. When it is empty for a region (the UK, at the time of writing), order without `availableNumberId`.

The carrier assigns a number at activation, usually within a few hours.

A US order without a picked number can carry a `zipCode` to ask for a number near that area.

### Email senders

`kind: "email"` with `emailName` and `emailDomain` orders a sender that appears as an email address (for example `support@yourbrand.com`).

The dashboard sells numbers only; email senders are ordered through the API and behave the same in the inbox.

## Register a sender you already own

If you hold a sender with the provider directly, [`POST /v1/imessage/senders`](/imessage/register-imessage-sender) attaches it to a profile without ordering anything. It carries the same monthly fee while active.

One sender per profile. Registering the same handle again refreshes it. A different handle returns `409` until the existing sender is canceled.

## Lifecycle and settings

- [`GET /v1/imessage/senders/order`](/imessage/list-imessage-sender-orders) lists every sender your team owns with its status: `ordering`, `activating`, `active`, `suspended`, `failed` or `canceled`.
- [`GET /v1/imessage/senders/{senderId}`](/imessage/get-imessage-sender) adds the provider's live view: platform `health` (`active`, `degradation`, `outage`) and the provider-hosted `imessageLink`, a web page that opens Messages on the sender from any Apple device.
- [`PATCH /v1/imessage/senders/{senderId}`](/imessage/update-imessage-sender) changes the display name and the contact card (name and square photo) recipients see when they save the number. The contact card is also what a `contactCard` send shares, so set it before using that option.
- [`DELETE /v1/imessage/senders/{senderId}`](/imessage/cancel-imessage-sender) cancels the sender at the provider and deactivates the account. Billing stops with the current month, with no proration or refund, like phone numbers.

## If it fails
| Status | Code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `402` | `payment_method_required` | No card on file for the profile owner |
| `422` | `usage_billing_required` | The workspace is not on usage-based billing |
| `409` | `imessage_sender_conflict` | The sender is already registered to another profile |
| `403` | `imessage_sender_limit` | The team's sender cap is reached |
| `502` | | The provider rejected the order; nothing was charged |
